## Description {#details}

<p>A DCE pass that assumes instructions are dead until proven otherwise.</p>


<p>This pass eliminates dead code by optimistically assuming that all instructions are dead until proven otherwise. This allows it to eliminate dead computations that other DCE passes do not catch, particularly involving loop computations.</p>
